gold_decisions.identity_explanation: The gold issue concerns the incorrect range of already-completed downward smoothing factors and the resulting failure to identify the algorithmic residual with the assembled matrix. ISSUE-001 instead diagnoses an orientation and change-of-variables error in the PCG preconditioned matrix and condition-number identity; it does not recognize the downward-product obligation.

The gold issue concerns omission or misnormalization of the exact level-zero coarse solve and its placement relative to the residual factors. ISSUE-001 concerns the opposite-orientation square-root transformation and condition-number formula, not the coarse-solve coefficient, residual, or level-zero treatment.

Both entries identify the false use of the inverse-square-root congruence B^{-1/2}AB^{-1/2} for a preconditioner B approximating A^{-1}, including the resulting failure of the claimed condition-number identity and the corrected B^{1/2}AB^{1/2} formulation.
gold_decisions.shared_mathematical_weakness: The displayed PCG transformation and Euclidean preconditioned matrix use the wrong square-root orientation, so the asserted equality with cond_A(BA) is false; the positive-square-root congruence is the supported formulation.

component_coverage.gold_component: The claimed condition-number identity uses B^{-1/2}AB^{-1/2} even though B approximates A^{-1}; the correct congruence is B^{1/2}AB^{1/2}, with the corresponding PCG transformation corrected.
component_coverage.recognition_explanation: ISSUE-001 explicitly derives the inconsistency in the change of variables, supplies the corrected preconditioned matrix, and states both the false inverse-square-root condition-number identity and the valid positive-square-root identity.
